[G]

[G]To hide the
[D]love that [Ebdim7]she denied
[Em]  [G7]

[G]it

[D][Ebdim7]And as I
[Em]go through [G7]my life

[B7sus4]

[Gmaj7]I found her diary underneath
[Fsus2/G]a tree

[G]me

[Fsus2/G]to flow

[Chorus]
[Edim7]The love she'd wai-

[D]someone else, [Ebdim7]not me

[Outro]
[D][Ebdim7]And as I
